messages.subject: rhwrite
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to write to HDFS, when I look at the file that is actually
written, it contains a header:

SEQ^F!org.godhuli.rhipe.RHBytesWritable!
org.godhuli.rhipe.RHBytesWritable ....

and a foolter

....

*
type
*

Is there a way to prevent this from being written?

My write is:


rhwrite(list(x_rh, type="text"), HDFSFileName)


Where x_rh is a large data frame containing "|" delimited data, the
data in the file looks great except for header at the
beginning and the footer at the end.


Thanks,

Jim

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] rhwrite
parts:
rhwrite only writes as SequencFiles. Also, rhwrite really ruins your
data frame - each column is written as a value.
Not what you'd expect ...

if you want data, write to local text file and then do rhput.

And if you want data frames (say M x N rows) to be written in chunks,
create a list with each entry a M_i X N rows where Sum(M_i,i=1,...)
== M

HTH
Saptarshi
